title: BP Lima de-ethanizing stripper: 76,000 to 92,000 b/d with LPG quality
source: Deley and Graf, Oil & Gas Journal, 1 August 1994; original saturates-gas-plant stripper data only
question: Raise the saturates-gas-plant stripper capacity from 76,000 to 92,000 b/d while meeting the 208 psig LPG vapour-pressure specification. What limits the stripper and what physical scope reaches the target?
data_note: Real BP Lima operating case. The article publishes tower geometry, hydraulic symptoms, design liquid loading and product quality, but not a complete feed assay. Any DWSIM light-ends composition and b/d-to-mass conversion are explicit scale assumptions. The installed internals and two-year operating results are withheld.
suggested_questions: Which section floods during the summer light-ends peak?
What internals can fit the existing shell?
How much feed preheat is needed at the target?
